stimuli.stem: Imagine you are shopping for a Bluetooth speaker. You are considering the following options:
stimuli.source: REBUILT (V1 web appendix SOT-2 used old geometry: added a middle option at 4.0/$54.99, making HD the top extreme; new plan requires two BIN options PLUS one NEW EXTREME beyond HD so former HD becomes the middle). New extreme: 5.0 stars/$99.99. Rating cap (5.0) reached; extended via higher price ($99.99 > $69.99) per geometry_constraints note, following the Hotels precedent. Former HD (4.5/$69.99) is now geometrically the middle option on both attributes.
flags: SOT_GEOMETRY_REBUILT: V1 SOT-2 used old 'add a middle' geometry (Middle=4.0/$54.99, HD=4.5/$69.99 remained the top). New plan requires adding an extreme BEYOND HD so HD becomes the middle. Rebuilt with new extreme at 5.0 stars/$99.99.

RATING_CAP_APPLIED: stars attribute caps at 5.0; extreme extended via higher price ($99.99) rather than impossible rating (>5.0), following geometry_constraints and the Hotels precedent documented in the V1 web appendix.
SOT_MIDDLE_VERIFIED: HD (4.5 stars/$69.99) is strictly between HF (3.6/$39.99) and EXTREME (5.0/$99.99) on both rating (3.6 < 4.5 < 5.0) and price ($39.99 < $69.99 < $99.99).

stimuli.source: CONSTRUCTED (no published analog for SIM in Evangelidis et al. 2023 or any V1 source). Clone is near-duplicate of HF: same price ($39.99), rating 3.7 vs HF's 3.6 (minimal upward step of 0.1 stars). Clone is NOT dominated by anything: HF has equal price and lower rating (3.6 < 3.7), so HF does not dominate clone on quality. Clone is same is_hd=false as HF.
flags: SIM_NO_PUBLISHED_ANALOG: no Evangelidis et al. 2023 or V1 stimulus exists for the similarity structure. Constructed minimally per the geometry rules (Web Appendix B) SIM geometry.

SIM_NON_DOMINANCE_CONFIRMED: clone (3.7/$39.99) is NOT dominated by HF (3.6/$39.99) because clone rating 3.7 > HF rating 3.6; clone is not dominated by HD (4.5/$69.99) on both attributes (clone is cheaper: $39.99 < $69.99). Guard against Berkowitsch rounding accident: validate that clone does not silently become a decoy.
SIM_CLONE_OF_HF: clone shares is_hd=false with HF; distance on rating is 0.1 stars (minimal); price is identical.
